mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have partly cloudy skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 83 degrees and a moderate air quality alert, plus we are looking at an overnight low of 66 with rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona continues its long-term partnership with AECOM Inc. for professional engineering services, with detailed reports provided to the City Council during every council meeting to keep the public updated on local infrastructure.
Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, while tomorrow features the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Paddy Mac's.
During the week of July 27 through August 3, Verona police were active, including one notable arrest for O W I that occurred last Thursday, July 30.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the delicious Really Reese's, and remember you can also visit the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park until 4 PM today.
